recent_articles.title: Hamirpur bridge collapse: Case lodged against executing agency, contractor - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Police** have registered a case against the executing agency and contractor of the Betwa river bridge in Hamirpur, accusing them of negligence and laxity. The case was filed by **State Bridge Corporation Deputy Project Manager Dilip Kumar**, who accused owner **Pawan Pratap Singh** and contractor **Nitish Kumar**. One assistant engineer has been suspended for negligence.  The incident occurred during a severe storm when a slab collapsed, killing six labourers and injuring three others while they were sleeping on the upper portion of the bridge.

recent_articles.title: Portion of platform shed collapses at Lucknow station, three injured - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Three** individuals, including a traveling ticket examiner (TTE) and two passengers, were injured when a portion of a platform shed collapsed at **Lucknow Junction Railway Station**. The incident occurred around 8:15 a.m. on platform number five, prompting panic among commuters.  **Railway Protection Force (RPF)**, **Government Railway Police (GRP)**, and railway officials rescued the injured after removing the collapsed structure. **Divisional Railway Manager (DRM) Sunil Kumar Verma** visited the hospital and ordered an inquiry into the incident, promising strict action against responsible parties.

recent_articles.title: Uttar Pradesh emphasised to prevent water-borne diseases in rural areas through community driven participation - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Uttar Pradesh** government is implementing a community-driven water quality testing initiative to prevent waterborne diseases in rural areas.  Women have been trained to use Field Testing Kits (FTKs) for early detection of contamination, strengthening local ownership and promoting self-sufficiency. The initiative, part of the Jal Jeevan Mission, has equipped groups of five women with FTKs in nearly all villages, leading to the testing of over 63,700 water samples this year.  The program also provides women with an opportunity for additional income through honorariums paid per test. **Raj Shekhar**, Managing Director of Uttar Pradesh Jal Nigam (Rural), stated that the initiative has led to immediate action against contaminated water sources and economic empowerment for rural women.

recent_articles.title: Two killed, 35 injured as sleeper bus rams truck on Agra-Lucknow Expressway - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A **sleeper bus** carrying 70 passengers collided with a rice-laden truck on the Agra-Lucknow Expressway in Uttar Pradesh, resulting in the deaths of driver Ram Jeevan (43) and passenger Ram Naresh (35). The accident occurred near milestone 83 under Karhal police station limits, leaving 35 passengers injured.  Police are investigating the cause of the crash, which involved the bus rear-ending the truck.

recent_articles.title: Indian Air Force likely to oversee transport of NEET-UG re-test papers - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The government** is considering using the **Indian Air Force (IAF)** to manage logistics and transportation for the NEET-UG 2026 re-test, scheduled for June 21.  A high-level meeting was held at the residence of **Defence Minister Rajnath Singh**, attended by **Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan** and **Communications Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia**. The IAF will provide transportation and logistics support to secure question papers from printing presses to examination centers across the country, aiming to minimize leak risks.  The final decision is pending consultations with the Prime Minister's Office.

recent_articles.title: Gujarat’s Banni grasslands: A heap of broken images, where the sun beats - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **NTPC Renewable Energy Limited** is planning to build a solar project on the Chhari Dhand wetland conservation reserve in Gujarat. The project has sparked controversy among local Maldhari pastoralists who rely on the grassland for their livelihood and believe it will negatively impact the ecosystem and their way of life.  The villagers have expressed concerns about the potential loss of grazing land, migratory bird populations, and access to the Kiro Hill, a significant landmark for the community. They are demanding a re-survey of the site and are actively protesting against the project. Conservationists also oppose the project due to its proximity to the wetland's ecological significance.  The company has not responded to requests for comment.

recent_articles.title: Meet Parveen Shaikh and Barkha Subba: The Indian conservationists who won the ‘Green Oscars’ for saving endangered species | - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Parveen Shaikh** and **Barkha Subba**, Indian conservationists, have been awarded the prestigious Whitley Awards 2026 for their work protecting endangered species and fragile ecosystems in India.  Shaikh's efforts to save the endangered Indian skimmer have seen nest survival rates increase from 14% to 27%, while Subba has dedicated herself to the preservation of the Himalayan salamander, focusing on habitat restoration and community engagement. The Whitley Awards are known as the "Green Oscars" and recognize grassroots conservation leaders from the Global South.  The awards will fund expanded conservation efforts in India, highlighting the importance of local communities and scientific commitment in addressing biodiversity loss and climate change.

recent_articles.title: JP Power shares soar 20% on optimism around Adani Power’s 24% stake purchase - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Adani Power** announced agreements to acquire a 24% stake in **Jaiprakash Associates Limited’s (JAL)** JPVL and the Churk thermal power plant for approximately Rs 2,993.6 crore and Rs 1,200 crore respectively. The acquisitions are part of the broader Adani Group-led resolution plan for debt-laden JAL and will strengthen **Adani Power’s** generation portfolio and expand its footprint in the thermal power sector.  The transactions are expected to close within 90 days from the NCLT approval granted on March 17, 2026. This comes as India experiences a heatwave amid an exceptionally strong El Niño year, leading to increased power demand.

recent_articles.title: Senco Gold shares fall 3% despite 151% jump in Q4 net profit; firm tops FY26 guidance - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Senco Gold** reported a 45% increase in revenue from operations to Rs 1,996.7 crore for the fourth quarter of FY26, driven by higher gold, silver, and platinum prices. The company's EBITDA margin also improved significantly, reaching 13.7%.  The retail sales reached an all-time high of Rs 1,731 crore with a 35% year-on-year growth. **Senco Gold** expanded its showroom network to 201 outlets during the fiscal year and achieved a 33% year-on-year revenue growth exceeding its stated FY26 guidance.

recent_articles.title: Six killed and 21 injured as bus overturns on Lucknow-Agra Expressway - The Hindu
recent_articles.sentiment_target: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath

The incident occurred at 5:15 am when the bus reportedly lost control after the driver fell asleep at the wheel. The bus collided with the divider and overturned, ejecting several passengers through the windows. **Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath** expressed condolences to the families of the deceased and wished for a speedy recovery for the injured.

recent_articles.title: Fuel shortage hits pumps amid panic buying; OMCs call for calm, say supply is steady - The Hindu

The **Centre** has implemented price hikes to mitigate losses for its oil marketing companies (OMCs), but this has led to supply disruptions and long queues at petrol stations.  In Maharashtra, **farmers** are struggling to procure diesel for their tractors, while in Punjab, the **Punjab Petrol Pump Dealers Association** reports short supplies of both petrol and diesel. The situation is impacting agricultural activities and transportation, with some fuel stations even running dry.  The **Petroleum Ministry** has assured the public that there is no shortage of fuel but urged people to avoid panic buying.

recent_articles.title: 2008 railway exam assault: Raj Thackeray's role in instigating attack not proved, says court - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: U.P. Congress chief Ajay Rai booked over ‘objectionable’ comment on PM Modi - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Public outcry grows louder over power cuts in U.P.; Oppn. parties call it structural failure - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Residents** of Uttar Pradesh are protesting frequent power cuts, exacerbated by the heat wave. **Opposition parties**, including the Samajwadi Party and Congress, have criticized the **Yogi Adityanath-led government** for its handling of the crisis, alleging a failure to expand power generation capacity and pointing to structural issues within the electricity department. The **Vidyut Karmchari Joint Sangharsh Samiti** has also blamed the vertical restructuring system implemented in the power corporation for the ongoing problems.

recent_articles.title: U.P. STF busts SSC exam-rigging racket in Greater Noida; seven held - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Uttar Pradesh Special Task Force (STF)** arrested seven individuals in Greater Noida for their involvement in rigging **Staff Selection Commission (SSC)** online recruitment examinations. The accused allegedly used proxy servers and dummy candidates to manipulate the exams for constables in the CAPF, SSF, and riflemen in the Assam Rifles.  **Pradeep Chauhan**, a Muzaffarnagar resident who established the online examination center "Balaji Digital Zone," was identified as the alleged mastermind of the racket. **The STF** recovered ₹50 lakh in cash, electronic devices, and other evidence during the raid. The investigation is ongoing with four other members of the gang still at large.

recent_articles.title: Uttar Pradesh woman killed by boyfriend after she refuses to accompany him - The Hindu

The incident occurred on Friday evening, with family members present.  Police say Ali Mohammad attacked Reshma after she refused to accompany him somewhere and both he and his associate, **Aliyas**, were apprehended at the scene. The body has been sent for a post-mortem examination, and police are continuing their investigation.

recent_articles.title: Slow-moving bands of heavy rain trigger flooding and landslides in parts of China | China | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Heavy rainfall across southern and central China has led to flash flooding, landslides, and waterlogging. The **Bay of Bengal**, **South China Sea**, and **Pacific Ocean** contributed to the prolonged downpour that caused 12 deaths and forced evacuations.  Meanwhile, extreme heat warnings have been issued for northern India, with temperatures exceeding 40°C (104°F) in several regions. These conditions are expected to persist until Wednesday when thunderstorms may develop.

recent_articles.title: Focus on infrastructure, agricultural productivity, developing clusters for export: U.P. State Transformation Commission CEO - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Uttar Pradesh** is focusing on infrastructure development, agricultural productivity, and export-oriented clusters to bridge the income gap between Western and Eastern districts. **Manoj Kumar Singh**, CEO of the State Transformation Commission, highlighted the state's focus on infrastructure projects like the Ganga Expressway and Noida International Airport, aiming to develop Jewar as a cargo hub for agricultural exports. The UP-AGREES project, funded by the World Bank, aims to increase agricultural productivity in 28 low-income districts across the state.

recent_articles.title: Lakshmi could have been a child bride - The Hindu

Her father initially dismissed the message but was persuaded by **anganwadi workers** and **village pradhan**.  The village now features painted messages advocating for change in response to Lakshmi's powerful lyrics.

recent_articles.title: Fake call centres duping U.S. citizens busted in Bengaluru, man from Delhi, another from U.P. arrested - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Karnataka State Cyber Command** officials raided four fake call centers in Bengaluru, uncovering a sophisticated operation that defrauded U.S. citizens by impersonating a prominent American accounting firm. The investigation revealed the use of shell companies to launder money and a network of over 120 employees trained to deceive victims using US accents. **Pronab Mohanty**, Director General of Cyber Command, stated that further investigations will focus on tracing the money trail and identifying bank accounts used in the fraud.

recent_articles.title: Modi, Shah are traitors who are attacking the Constitution, says Rahul at Rae Bareli meet - The Hindu

Gandhi unveiled a statue of Veera Pasi in Rae Bareli, highlighting his party's renewed focus on the community. recent_articles.title: Mayawati demands extensive relief for storm victims in Uttar Pradesh - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Adhikari aide killing: CBI conducts searches at multiple locations - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The CBI** conducted searches at multiple locations in connection with the murder of West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari's aide Chandrakant Rath. The agency took over the investigation from the **West Bengal Police**, forming a seven-member special investigation team under a DIG of Special Crime from Delhi. recent_articles.title: NIA chargesheets ‘mastermind,’ four others in Cambodia-linked ‘cyber slavery’ case - The Hindu

The syndicate lured Indian youth to Cambodia under false pretenses for legitimate jobs and lucrative salaries. Victims were forced to work for scam companies, subjected to mental and physical torture, including electric shocks, forceful confinement, and denial of food and water.  The NIA is working to track down the remaining members of the syndicate.

recent_articles.title: Insensitivity and lack of concern, alleges Congress on Center’s silence over U.P. storm deaths - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: ECI set to roll out phase III of SIR in ‘coming days’ to cover 22 States, UTs - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Crumbling of Awadh’s heritage amidst monument encroachments - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A report by the Comptroller and Auditor General of India (CAG) highlights the concerning state of protected monuments in Uttar Pradesh. The report found that 31 centrally protected monuments are untraceable, with only 31 monuments having proper ownership documentation and 96 being encroached upon.
